extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners and USPTO enrollment & discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and requirements for an affidavit of resignation (exclusion on consent) under 37 C.F.R. § 11.27, the related disciplinary rules alleged against a practitioner, and the procedural consequences (publication, dismissal, and reinstatement presumption).

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit of Resignation pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.27(a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent acknowledges in his Affidavit of Resignation that: (1) his consent is freely and voluntarily rendered, and he is not being subjected to coercion or duress; (2) he is aware that a disciplinary complaint is pending against him and the complaint's allegations (detailed in the order); (3) he is aware that the disciplinary complaint alleges violations of specified Disciplinary Rules; (4) without admitting the allegations, he acknowledges that if he applies for reinstatement the OED Director will conclusively presume the allegations are true and that he could not have successfully defended himself; (5) he has fully read and understands 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.5(b), 11.27, 11.58, 11.59, and 11.60 and is aware of the consequences of consenting to exclusion; and (6) he consents to being excluded from practice before the USPTO in patent, trademark, and other non-patent matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director found the Affidavit of Resignation complies with 37 C.F.R. § 11.27(a) and therefore approved the affidavit and ordered exclusion on consent commencing on the date of the Final Order.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proscribing engaging in disreputable or gross misconduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proscribing engaging in conduct involving dishonesty, fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proscribing engaging in conduct that is prejudicial to the administration of justice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(c)(2)(i)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proscribing knowingly giving false and/or misleading information or knowingly participating in a material way in giving false and/or misleading information to a client in connection with any immediate, prospective, or pending business before the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.77(c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proscribing neglecting a legal matter entrusted to a practitioner.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.84(a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proscribing failing to seek the lawful objectives of a client through reasonably available means permitted by law, failing to carry out a contract of employment entered into with a client for professional services, and/or prejudicing or damaging a client during the course of a professional relationship.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proscribing engaging in other conduct that adversely reflects on the practitioner's fitness to practice before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: USPTO Director's authority to approve exclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to 35 U.S.C. §§ 2(b)(2)(D) and 32 and 37 C.F.R. § 11.27, the USPTO Director has the authority to approve an Affidavit of Resignation and to exclude a practitioner from practice before the Office in patent, trademark, and other non-patent matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director exercised this authority in determining the Respondent's Affidavit complied with 37 C.F.R. § 11.27(a) and issued the Final Order of exclusion on consent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reinstatement presumption under 37 C.F.R. § 11.60
rubrics_metrics.description: If and when the excluded practitioner applies for reinstatement under 37 C.F.R. § 11.60, the OED Director will conclusively presume, for the purpose of determining the reinstatement application, that (a) the allegations set forth in the disciplinary complaint are true, and (b) the practitioner could not have successfully defended himself against such allegations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This presumption is acknowledged in the Affidavit and is a consequence of consenting to exclusion under § 11.27.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation for Respondent to comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order specifically orders the Respondent to comply with § 11.58 (relating to duties of excluded practitioners—e.g., notice requirements), though the order does not restate the text of § 11.58.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation for OED Director to comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.59
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.59.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order directs the OED Director to follow § 11.59 (procedures for publication/notification), without restating the regulation's text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation for Respondent to comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.60 upon any request for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent shall comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.60 upon any request for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The order emphasizes that reinstatement will be governed by § 11.60 and that the respondent has acknowledged the consequences in his affidavit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and notice requirements for exclusion orders
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall electronically publish the Final Order at the Office of Enrollment and Discipline's FOIA Reading Room and shall publish the specified Notice of Exclusion on Consent in the Official Gazette, including recitation of the allegations and cited disciplinary rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order includes the full text of the Notice of Exclusion on Consent to be published and the specific URLs/locations for posting (e-FOIA OED Reading Room and Official Gazette).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dismissal of pending disciplinary proceeding upon exclusion on consent
rubrics_metrics.description: USPTO Disciplinary Proceeding No. D2014-10 is hereby dismissed as a result of the Respondent's approved Affidavit of Resignation and exclusion on consent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order explicitly dismisses the pending disciplinary proceeding upon approval of the resignation/exclusion.
